verdict.rationale: Inngest's first-party docs say self-hosting is supported as of the 1.0 release and acknowledge that developers may want to self-host. The GitHub repo confirms functions can sync with 'a self-hosted Inngest server.' SSPL licensing comments concern open-source status, not whether you can self-host, so they do not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, and documented detail in the pack on self-host setup, dependencies and feature parity with the cloud.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Self-hosting support for Inngest is supported as of the 1.0 release.
Sync your application's functions with the Inngest Platform or a self-hosted Inngest server.
we understand that developers may want to self-host for a variety of reasons.
